name: SufficiencyBench
description: A benchmark for context sufficiency detection in RAG that independently controls context sufficiency and model confidence.

changelog.1.1: 2026-10-06. All runs of whitespace inside every context collapsed to a single space in both conditions and prompts rebuilt accordingly. In v1.0 the sufficient contexts kept the double spaces of the source passages while the edited insufficient contexts were re-joined with single spaces, which made the number of double spaces a label cue (0.775 AUROC overall, 0.991 on HotpotQA) that the hidden-state probes partly exploited. 95 questions whose two contexts were identical once all whitespace was removed (whitespace-only edits, mostly sentence-join differences such as "grounds.[citation needed]" against "grounds. [citation needed]") were removed. Questions, gold answers, ids, splits and parametric-knowledge labels are unchanged. v1.0 is kept in sufficiency_bench_v1.0/.
